patternCandidates.name: Document upload page (front/back capture)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain must submit a two-sided ID/licence (DL, Aadhaar) and its number
patternCandidates.structure: Header (back, title, Help, call) > optional info banner w/ audio > Front card (dashed or bordered, sample illustration, primary Upload Front) > Back card (disabled until front) > ID-number TextField w/ example + validation hint > sample illustration > sticky footer: primary Submit + outline opt-out ('I do not have a license' / 'Upload later')
patternCandidates.variations: Dashed tile vs card-with-illustration (Aadhaar); Upload Front yellow vs 'Upload Photo' w/ add_photo icon; after upload image fills tile with floating 'Retake' pill
patternCandidates.conflicts: Header is a hand-built Left Arrow+Help+call row on DL/Aadhaar but Runway InternalPageHeader on RC/newer DL (2985:34426); opt-out label varies ('I do not have a license' / 'I Do Not Have A License' / 'I do not have Driving License' / 'Upload Later')

patternCandidates.name: Optional document upload (number + optional photos)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Doc where number is required but photo optional (RC)
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader > info banner w/ audio > number TextField > illustration w/ callout > 'Upload RC photos' + Tag 'Not Compulsory' > 2 square dashed image tiles > sticky Submit (+ 'I Do Not Have Vehicle RC')

patternCandidates.name: Document-classifier rejection
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Uploaded image is not the requested document
patternCandidates.structure: A) inline: red full-width error banner under header + failed image with red border + inline 'Upload again'; B) bottom sheet: image w/ red border, red-tint error box (warning icon, title, body), primary Retake, outline opt-out
patternCandidates.conflicts: Two treatments for the same error both on the ✅ final page — pick one

patternCandidates.name: Blocking progress modal
patternCandidates.structure: Dimmed page > centred white card: yellow ring spinner, bold 'Please Wait', sub-line stating the action

patternCandidates.name: Onboarding status checklist

patternCandidates.structure: Status banner (colour by overall state: blue pending / peach verifying / red failed; title + 'N steps left' + illustration) > step cards (icon tile, label, coloured status; trailing yellow 'Upload' pill, hourglass, or 'Upload Again')
patternCandidates.conflicts: Doc Centre (1015:27636) uses a different list style for the same data
